BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Good questions.
Clear answers.

How do I get started?

No account is needed. Select “Submit a sample” and add a contact email. Saving keeps a draft in this browser; it does not send a request or email. Email updates will become available once notifications are connected.

How do I verify a certificate of analysis?

Enter the COA Lookup Code shown on the certificate to open its report. Report and submission numbers are separate identifiers.

What should I send to the laboratory?

Sample quantity, packaging, shipping conditions, and documentation depend on the requested analysis. These requirements should be confirmed with the laboratory before shipping.

Where can I see pricing and turnaround?

Confirm pricing and turnaround with the laboratory for your analysis. Saving a request draft does not collect a payment.
